data.one_liner: Pure-Dart Nostr protocol library supporting events, signing, encryption, and 35+ NIPs.
data.what_it_does: Provides protocol-level handling for Nostr events, key management, cryptographic operations, and 35+ NIP implementations in pure Dart. It is transport-agnostic and fully compatible with Flutter Web.
use_when: Building Nostr clients or relays in Flutter or pure Dart
Needing web-compatible Nostr event signing and encryption
avoid_when: You need built-in WebSocket transport (the library is transport-agnostic)
You only require legacy NIP-04 plaintext DMs which have been removed
strengths: Implements modern standards like NIP-17 direct messages and NIP-59 gift wrap
weaknesses: Does not include built-in transport/WebSocket handling
Requires manual implementation for partially supported NIPs like NIP-46 or NIP-47 URI parsing
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml using pub add nostr.

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If working with EVM-compatible blockchains instead of the Nostr protocol.
